Is A Place for Every Potion made with AI?

Yes. A Place for Every Potion discloses AI-generated content on Steam for art, music and code, according to its developer, CubeQuad Games.

⚠️ Uses AI-generated content (disclosed)AI art & imagesAI music & soundAI-assisted code

The developer describes how A Place for Every Potion uses AI-generated content like this:

I am a solo developer with ten years of experience, who started out as a 3D artist. Every piece of 3D art in this game was made by me: the models, the UVs, the LODs. All of the game code and architecture was designed and programmed by me. I used AI to assist me with some of the textures and the music. This is a solo project with no funding and I wanted it to follow my vision so I needed any help I could get. If I ever could afford to hire people, that is what I am going to do, so we can deliver even better quality games! [UPDATE] Since many players requested, I replaced the AI music with human-made music. And one nice freelancer volunteered to help with textures. Not sure if we can make it until the release though but will try!

Developer: CubeQuad Games · Released: Oct 28, 2026 · Checked 2026-10-27 · View on Steam
